message: I really appreciate your break-down of "economics."  Looks like you're doing some really cool work.  I noticed your reading list for your future grad class on economics in composition.  I've been reading Deb Brandt's _Lit in Am Lives_, Brian Street's _Social Literacies_ and other texts that discuss literacy/"economy" connections.  Your posts last week have given me a lot to think about as far as "economy" is concerned.  Any must-read books you could suggest??
